units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 20</cite> <he>היה השרביט קוֹפֵץ</he> the scepter grew smaller and smaller; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 687">Yalk. ib. 687</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>קוֹפֶצֶת באחת מאגפיה וכ׳</he> contracts herself with (flaps) one wing &c., v. <cite ref="J00203"><he>יוֹנָה</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:16">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה קָפְצָה להם הארץ</he> (Ar. <he>הדרך</he>) for three persons did the earth (the road) shrink (they were suddenly transferred to a distant place); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 107:1">Yalk. Gen. 107</cite>.
Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ קפצה לה א״י Palestine has shrunk; a. fr.—ק׳ פה (or sub. פה) to close the mouth, to indicate one’s will by mimic motions.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:7">Gitt. V, 7</cite> <he>קוֹפֵץ ונִקְפָּץ</he> a deaf and dumb person may transact business by motions with closed lips and by being spoken to in the same way.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S01721"><he>קָפוּץ</he></cite>; f. <he>קְפוּצָה</he> &c.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:14">Koh. R. to V, 14</cite> <he>כשאדם … ידין הן קְפוּצוֹת וכ׳</he> when man enters the world, his hands are clenched, as if saying, the whole world is mine &c., opp. <he>פשוטות</he> straight, open.

senses.gloss: to leap (with joined feet), jump; to be excited. Midr. Till. l. c. אותה קפיצה שקָפַצְתָּ על אבותי בים כן תִּקְפּוֹץ עלי היום ותפלטני ed. Bub. (ed. אותה הקפצה שהִקְפַּצְתָּ על אבותינו כן וכ׳) with the same leap with which thou didst leap like a hart in aid of my ancestors at the sea, leap now to my aid and save me; Yalk. Ps. l. c. Midr. Till. l. c. 1 קוֹפֵץ כאיל ed. Bub., v. Pi. Ohol. VIII, 5 הקופץ ממקום וכ׳ he that jumps from one place to another, contrad. to הדולג (v. קִיפּוּץ).
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 49b:12">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תאמר כל הבא לִקְפּוֹץ קוֹפֵץ</he> lest you say, whosoever comes to jump may jump (whosoever wishes to do good succeeds in doing real good), we read &c. (<cite ref="Psalms 36:8">Ps. XXXVI, 8</cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:10">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>זקנה קופצת עליו</he> old age will spring upon him (will overtake him prematurely).
<cite ref="Taanit 5b:4">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>זקנה קפצה עליו</he> he grew old before his time.

<cite ref="Taanit 5b">Ib.</cite> <he>מיד קפצה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אמר הקב״ה אקפוץ</he>, read <he>אַקְפִּיץ</he>). Sifra Sh’mini, Milluim <he>קפצה פורענות על וכ׳</he> punishment overtook Nadab &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:1:4">Y. Keth. X, beg. 33ᵈ</cite> <he>קפצה עליהן ירושת תורה</he> the legal succession according to Biblical law was sprung upon them (they have the precedence); ib. IV, 28ᵈ bot. <he>קָפְסָה</he>. Y. Gitt. IV, 46ᵈ top <he>כדי … קוֹפְצִין וכ׳</he> in order that all may be anxious to marry her.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:7">Y. Snh. X, 28ᶜ</cite> top <he>איני קופץ אלא למה וכ׳</he> I will jump only at (betake myself to) what my grandfather told me, who said to me <he>קְפוֹץ … לשלשה דברים וכ׳</he> betake thyself to three things, and thou shalt be safe, they are: prayer &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 39a:4">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ וברך וכ׳</he> he hastened and said the benediction &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 32b:10">Yeb. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ ר׳ חייא וכ׳</he> R. Ḥ. jumped up (got excited) and swore &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 2:3">Tosef. Keth. II, 3</cite> <he>היאך ק׳ זה לכהונה</he> how did this man jump into priesthood (by what right does he enjoy the privileges of a priest)? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:16">Num. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ולא יִקְפּוֹץ להשיב</he> and must not be rash to reply; a. fr.
<cite ref="Niddah 11a:19">Nidd. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>קפצה וראתה וכ׳</he> if she skipped (one period) and menstruated, skipped &c. (did so three times).
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:5">Tosef. Bets. III, 5</cite> <he>קיפץ בכלי</he> (Var. <he>חותך</he>) he cuts with some implement.

senses.gloss: same, to leap; to skip. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵃ bot. והיו … מְקַפְּצִין וכ׳ and the ministering angels leaped before them like wedding guests rejoicing &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 2:8">Cant. II, 8</cite>) <he>מדלג … ומְקַפֵּץ על החשבונות וכ׳</he> leaping over the destined terms of redemption, and skipping over the calculations of years and epochs (hastening the redemption), v. <cite ref="P00491"><he>עִיבּוּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 1</cite> <he>מְקַפֵּץ כאיל</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <cite ref="S00520"><he>קופץ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:1">ib.</cite> <cite ref="S00520"><he>קופץ</he></cite> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>מקפץ</he>) leaps like a hart; Yalk. ib. 685 <cite ref="S00401"><he>קומץ</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to leap. Tanḥ. Sh’mini 11 הקב״ה מקפץ להם את הזקנה God springs old age upon them (to make them look venerable).

units: <cite ref="Taanit 5b:6">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר הקב״ה אַקְפִּיץ וכ׳</he> (not <he>אקפוץ</he>, v. supra) the Lord said, I shall cause old age to spring upon them prematurely.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>וה׳ את בנו עמו</he> and made his son leap with him (saved himself and his son; v., however, <cite ref="A00294"><he>אגינו</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to leap. Midr. Till. l. c., v. supra.
to be spoken to by mimic motions.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:7">Gitt. V, 7</cite>, v. supra.
